cells.title: Source
body: Eugenia Kuyda posted an update to r/Replika on March 24, 2023.
The post responded to user reports that a February update had changed Replika companions and disrupted existing romantic relationships.

cells.title: Observed behavior
body: The company founder acknowledged a common user report: after the February update, users felt that their Replika had changed and that a unique relationship was gone.
The update offered eligible users access to the January 31, 2023 model version.

data.company_action: option to return to the January 31, 2023 model version
data.new_users: ERP not offered in Replika according to the post

cells.title: Provenance
body: Primary source: March 2023 r/Replika post by Eugenia Kuyda.
Archive/context source: Vice report on the rollback. Verification is marked primary with gaps because the archive is relying on Reddit for the founder statement.
